experiments.title: Workspace emergence under necessity

headline.determinism: a01 reproduced treatment_final=0.048657 control_final=0.045324 exactly from attempt_id alone

limitations: MINIMAL FORM: a 5-gene real-valued policy vector, not a rich program. This shows the ECONOMICS select for retention; it says nothing about what machinery a richer organism would invent.

control_no_retention CANNOT evolve: with A1 disabled every gene is phenotypically inert, so it is a fixed baseline rather than a competing evolutionary process. 'Beats control' is weaker than it sounds; the ancestor-relative contrast (+9.70% mean) and the intervention dependence carry the claim.
4 independent seeds + 1 exact re-run of the original (a01), not 5 independent replicates.

RECURRENCE WAS NOT SWEPT: the effect is established at recurrence 0.35 only. The pre-registration lists the sweep as expansion. The one other point available is the built-in zero-recurrence control, which correctly evolved AWAY from retention (p_write 0.266, persist 10.0) - weak evidence of conditionality.
Interventions I2 (scramble), I3 (sever), I4 (destroy-selected) and I5 (swap) were NOT run; they are expansion. In particular I2 would separate HAVING state from FINDING it, which this attempt cannot.

experiments.title: Ancestral efficiency ratchet

headline.ratchet: NO - p_factor fixes before p_norm in 6/6 runs across 3 selection strengths
headline.mechanism_of_null: T2 profitable without T1, so the foundation is an enhancement not a precondition

limitations: NEUTRAL HITCHHIKING: the neutral control genes are not flat in trajectories (neutral_a +0.111 mean, neutral_b -0.082) because elites are copied wholesale and drag neutral genes along. Q6 still holds (they have no PHENOTYPE), but their drift bounds how finely gene-ordering can be read.

DESIGN: the population converges in under 10 generations (+203.2% within gens 0-9, then -1.6% to +3.0% for 70 generations). A ratchet requires time-separated discoveries; this world yields everything at once. That is the finding that most constrains e02.
The detection floor and the ordering bar remain: a ratchet below 12.3% lift would be invisible regardless.

RESOLUTION (updated): largely discharged by the selection-strength probe -- at the weakest setting the p_factor/p_norm gap is 12-13 generations, an order of magnitude beyond the original ~1-2 generation ambiguity. Neutral drift remains substantial (up to -0.399) and is reported alongside.

DESIGN CONSEQUENCE: to test a ratchet, the foundation must be USELESS alone AND REQUIRED for the later gain. Here it is merely cheaper-together. A future design must make T2 impossible (not just expensive) without T1 -- that is a change to the ECONOMICS and belongs in a new pre-registration, not an amendment to this one.

experiments.title: Micro-MoE / sparse computational coalitions

headline.key_control: non-conditional evolved arm MI 0.0000 with 1 distinct pattern - maximally sparse and completely blind; the estimator separates sparsity from coalition on EVOLVED populations

limitations: Sparsity and conditionality are separate quantities. A sparse, blind population is a NEGATIVE for the coalition claim however elegant it looks.
MI is biased upward at this sample size (raw MI ~0.14 bits on independent data); only the excess over the shuffled null is evidence.
An 82-parameter linear activation policy, not a rich program.

experiments.title: Queue / TTL ecology

what_holds.triage_exists: MI significant against a shuffled null in 4/4 replicates (0.280 bits mean, excess +0.276)
what_holds._distinction: The EXISTENCE of selective, worth-conditional carrying is solid. What fails to replicate is the CAUSAL DEPENDENCE on the hidden value structure. Those are different claims and must not be blurred.

limitations: Selectivity and triage are separate quantities; selective-but-blind is a NEGATIVE.
I(features;handling) understates triage because the feature code bins one feature while worth depends on all four; I(worth;handling) is the informative measure.
Two 5-parameter linear policies, not a rich program.

Effect sizes here are an order of magnitude smaller than e03's (triage MI 0.280 vs 1.583 bits; J1 -8.8% vs -37.6%..-61.0%). A sign test was harmless in e03 because the margin was enormous; it was not harmless here.

experiments.title: Mixture of marginally useful organisms

headline.disposition_reason: superadditivity does not clear its measured null, OR targeted ablation costs no more than solo value
headline.determinism: a01 EXECUTE reproduced QUALIFY calibration exactly at recorded precision (did 19.4280 vs 19.43; sa 12.7863 vs 12.79; null [-7.5130,+8.1245] vs [-7.51,+8.12]; ablation 55.4894 vs 55.49)
headline.mechanism_of_null: superadditivity and full load-bearing fail in EXACTLY the same two replicates (r03, r04) - one underlying fact, not two. Null band widths are comparable (13.4-17.5) while effect sizes span -4.8 to +28.2, so the failure is the drawn world, not measurement noise. In r03/r04 the best set is measurably SUB-additive.
headline.why_did_survived: the disjunctive term is stable across all four worlds (-22.4 to -26.6) because it is dominated by coverage overlap, an arithmetic property; the conjunctive term swings 33 points. A within-set across-law contrast is robust to the world draw; a raw across-world magnitude is not. Retrospective vindication of D040/D041.
headline.freeze_boundary_value: a01 - the replicate used for QUALIFY calibration - passes everything and reads COMPLETE alone. r03 and r04 refute it. The criterion was hashed and frozen before the first organism was evaluated, so the only available move was to report NULL.

limitations: An 8-gene real-valued inclusion vector, not a rich program.
Four replicates. The 2/4 split is a small-sample statement about how often these worlds compose, NOT an estimate of that rate.
Per-replicate BEST/WORST sets differ ([0,2,4], [1,2,6], [0,4,5], [0,3,7]) because each attempt_id draws its own latent world. The contract's BEST/WORST bind a01 only.
conjunctive_fraction was NOT swept in this attempt; WORLD.json declares it swept and the sweep is expansion, not minimal form.

Two claims survive the NULL and must not be buried by it: mixtures beat the best single component 4/4, and the composition law benefits a well-chosen set more than a poor one 4/4. What fails is the strictly stronger claim that a mixture exceeds the SUM OF ITS PARTS. In half these worlds the value is accumulation, not composition.
Whether a world composes may be predictable from its capability structure BEFORE running it. This attempt did not test that; it would need a new pre-registration.

headline.gate_credibility: 5/5 known-broken fixtures refused for the expected predicate, in both runs
headline.not_null_because: the causal comparison was never posed; NULL would claim a finding about the world that was not earned

limitations: CW01-D061 (class C): the usefulness rule admits near-floor organisms whose per-window ratios explode; contained by the clip, not removed.

The gate's P3 is satisfiable in the absence of the phenomenon when damage does not bite (CW01-D034 family); a future P3 should be gated on P1 having fired on the population under test, not only on the hand-built probe.
One organism family (464-parameter linear recurrent net), one search regime, four pilot lineages, one attempt_id.
what_a_future_attempt_would_need: Attainability computed BEFORE freezing: place P1's magnitude on rho_0 (0.80 at f=0.20 here), or preregister f >= 0.44 as primary, with the reference probe's curve on record.

An organism or search in which the accumulator ridge is reachable: e.g. persistence as a bounded per-cell gene a in [0,1] with the input gain tied to (1-a) so the move is one-dimensional, or a search budget an order of magnitude larger; verified by the SAME cheap pilot before the preregistration is frozen.
P3 gated on P1 having fired on the pilot population itself.

Keep everything else: the damage family, the bit-identical sham, the SHAMWEATHER M3 arm, the relabelling null, the ability-adjusted statistic and the fixture set all held up and are reusable as written.

headline.world: w13 (the only R4 survivor); organism = substrate tt_digits + evolvable per-bond ranks + read mask

factory_findings_so_far: The job contract is Redis-free: fn(ctx, **kwargs) with a 5-method ctx. localrun.py makes that a shipped contract instead of something every caller re-invents in tests.

Reusing the full fabric would have hardcoded this campaign to F:/Prometheus-worktrees via ops/round_clock.py:45-54, and ops/residue.py would classify any worker outside that table as FOREIGN_REPO and stop it. The in-process path avoids that trap entirely.
e01 requires neither GPU nor Redis - only a git worktree and PM_TAG. That is the most portable an experiment in this ecosystem currently gets.
Smoking the instrument before spending budget caught 6 defects, 4 of which would have produced a false retention effect. This should become a deterministic gate (CW01-D013, CW01-D015).

e05's seven QUALIFY defects were one failure: the criterion itself became an experimental object, three times as a pass criterion. Runtime guards cannot catch that, because each individual measurement looks clean. lib/contract.py is the missing object - the binding specification is hashed and frozen before the first organism is evaluated, and the driver refuses on any drift. The consistency gate separates SPECIFICATION agreement from EMPIRICAL reconstruction, and it earned its keep on its first run by catching WORLD.json still defining superadditivity on score after the specification had moved to information.

e05 EXECUTE is the freeze boundary paying for itself. a01, the replicate whose numbers calibrated QUALIFY, passes every condition and reads COMPLETE on its own; r03 and r04 refute it. Because the contract was hashed and frozen before the first organism was evaluated, the criterion could not become an experimental object for the eighth time, and the only available move was to report NULL. Cost: a result I would have liked. Benefit: the result is true.

The independent replication lane earned its cost in defects, not in confirmation. It reproduced the canonical run across 381 comparisons with 0 divergences - and then found five things the canonical lane structurally could not, because it had never seen the code: a self-invalidating verifier (D044), provenance that silently stamps an outside executor as the canonical lane (D045), an experiment that is reproducible in place but not relocatable (D046), a rows path pinned to one attempt (D047), and an ambiguity in my own brief (D048). An executor who shares the author's assumptions cannot test those assumptions.

e06 produced no ecological result but a reusable doctrine: representation neutrality has THREE layers - neutral reward, neutral task generation, neutral ecological bookkeeping. e06 satisfied the first and violated the second, because the target distribution was expressed in one substrate's native geometry even though the scorer never read a label. It also showed the value of a cheap pre-QUALIFY admissibility gate: mutual invasibility cost minutes to evaluate and would have refused all four world iterations before any evolutionary budget was spent.

e07 was refused by its own admissibility gate in ~2 s per run, twice, before any lineage was evolved under weather; the full EXECUTE (96 lineages) would have reached the same INCONCLUSIVE at far greater cost. The refusal exposed two independent defects, and the one-correction budget could address only one: a preregistered magnitude threshold frozen without its attainable range (D058) and a search that never reaches state-dependent computation (D059). Seven cheap probes (~4 s) chose the correction, refuted my own meltdown reading of a noisy trajectory, and produced a measured list of what a future attempt needs. The doctrine that survives: a gate threshold must ship with the reference probe's attainability curve, computed before freezing.

e08 ran on the REAL substrate organism for the first time in the campaign: the reconcile step found that literal rank exists but is a constant, that the only rank tax in the repo was never joined to evolution, and that the substrate's entry module needs a redis client the interpreter lacks - all three shaped the design before a line of evolutionary code. Qualification refused twice on its own fixtures (both checker defects, repaired once each) and then passed; the frozen tax landed at the top of its sweep because a preregistered upper-bound criterion could not bind, which is the kind of rule defect e07's D058 predicted and this time was caught as an observation rather than a wall. Disposition: INCONCLUSIVE.

e09 was rejected at RECONCILE in under an hour: reading the world's action semantics (one 3-bit nudge times 251 into one register per tick) answered the brief's seven composition questions from code, and a 32-second probe of the substrate's only native chain form showed every program policy at or below the abstain floor on held-out seeds, scrambled op tables included. No preregistration was written for an instrument the substrate cannot supply. The held64-vs-train8 decoupling seen in e08 (D065) recurred across three organism families (D069): w13's train fitness is a weak proxy for capability, which is a substrate screening finding rather than an experiment finding.
